messages:
alice: Quick ping — I opened a small PR that combines a dashboard rollup query fix + a couple lint nits. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/9123

bob: Skimming now. Is this touching the usage aggregation we're relying on for the per-route cost graph?

alice: Yep, the rollup was missing an index on `route_id` which made some recent buckets show 0s. Also renamed one metric key (`console.request_count` -> `console.requests.total`) — kept a compat shim for older dashboards.

bob: Will that break alerts?

alice: I added a mapping in the dashboard json and a migration script in the PR. Alerts should still fire but please double-check the `alerts/cost_surge` rule.

carol: tagging @dave for the metrics rename nit. I can look at dashboard JSON after lunch. :coffee:

ci-bot: CI: build passed · unit tests passed · e2e flaky tests skipped · coverage decreased by 0.2%

dave: quick read — one inline comment about the metric name being a little too generic, suggested `console.requests.count` instead of `.total` for consistency with other metrics. small nit on a test assertion too.

alice: thanks — pushed a commit addressing the test and renamed to `console.requests.count`. Kept a short note in the changelog.

erin: I ran the migration locally against a staging snapshot, looks good. Dashboards render with data now. :thumbsup:

frank: I can give an approval for the telemetry side. left one suggestion about adding a comment in the migration script explaining the rollback approach.

alice: added comment and a small rollback snippet. PTAL again when you have a sec.

frank: approve

erin: approve

bob: approve — tiny question answered, good to me

alice: plan is to squash+merge around 17:30 PT unless anyone objects. I will also run the alert smoke test after merge.

carol: no objections from me, thanks for moving fast on this.

alice: final note: snippet from the migration script if useful:

```bash
# migrate metric keys in TSDB
for key in $(curl -s "http://tsdb-admin.local/keys?prefix=console.request"); do
  new_key=$(echo "$key" | sed 's/console.request_count/console.requests.count/')
  curl -X POST "http://tsdb-admin.local/rename" -d "from=$key&to=$new_key"
done
```

alice: merging in ~20m unless someone yells. :rocket:
